admin.title: System configuration
admin.openNewTab: Open System configuration in a new tab
admin.modelsHelp: Connect your providers and choose which models appear in chat.
admin.fileStorageHelp: Store research files on the backend or in an S3-compatible bucket.
admin.documentSearchHelp: Choose how documents are searched. Embeddings and reranking save separately.
admin.configurationSourceHelp: Where this backend loads configuration and how changes persist.
admin.systemStatusHelp: Read-only backend diagnostics. Refresh to request current values.
admin.keepSecret: Key stored. Leave blank to keep it. Only a newly entered key can be shown.
admin.secretNotConfigured: Leave blank if your service does not require a key.
admin.discardHelp: These edits have not been saved. Stay and continue editing, or discard them before leaving.
admin.persistenceUnavailableHelp: The backend did not report valid persistence metadata. Do not assume changes will survive a restart.
admin.runtimeHelp: Changes apply to this backend process only and are lost after restart. Update the vault separately to keep them.
admin.localPersistenceSummary: Changes save to the backend's local .env file
admin.localPersistenceHelp: Changes are written to the backend's local .env file. No injected vault session was detected.
admin.localFileWarning: Credentials may still exist in plaintext on disk. Injected values take precedence, but missing values may still load from this file. Nothing has been deleted.
admin.savedRuntime: Applied to this process only. Local .env was not changed. Update your {provider} project to keep changes after restart.
admin.persistenceUnconfirmed: Configuration accepted, but persistence status was not reported. Reload saved values before assuming the change is durable.
admin.saveUnconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. Your draft is still available. Reload saved values to check the backend before retrying.
admin.operationUnconfirmed: This operation could not be confirmed. Close this dialog and reload saved values before retrying.
admin.reconcileHelp: A previous write could not be confirmed. Reload the saved configuration before sending another change. Your routing draft will be retained.
admin.reconciled: Saved values reloaded. Review any remaining draft before saving.
admin.loadFailed: Configuration could not be loaded. Check that the backend is running, then retry.
admin.configRefreshFailed: The configuration refresh failed. The last loaded values remain visible; retry to check the backend.
admin.routingHelp: Quick tasks use the supporting model. Backup follows the existing fallback policy; leave its model ID blank for no configured backup. Choosing a connection does not choose or verify a model.
admin.temperatureHelp: Controls response variation. Keep the saved value unless you intend to change it.
admin.connectionsHelp: Connections configured for this app. Open one to manage its models.
admin.connectionFormHelp: Set the name, endpoint, and credentials for this provider connection.
admin.endpointHelp: Use the API endpoint supplied by your provider, including its API path where required.
admin.newDestinationKey: The destination or protocol changed. Enter a key explicitly before testing. Saving with a blank key keeps the old credential for future model requests to the new destination.
admin.testCost: Sends a short model request. This can use your provider quota or incur a charge. No research documents are sent.
admin.testModelHelp: Enter a model this connection can access. The test covers this endpoint, key, protocol, and model only.
admin.nativeTestHelp: The current native Anthropic test requires a Claude model ID. Other aliases can be saved, but cannot be verified accurately by this test endpoint.
admin.testNotConfirmed: The test request did not succeed.
admin.testRequestFailed: The test could not be completed. Check the backend and try again; this does not establish that your key is invalid.
admin.saveIsNotTest: You can save without testing. A test only checks the inputs used at that moment.
admin.noConnectionsHelp: Add a provider, then add the model IDs you want to use in chat.
admin.keepOneConnection: At least one connection must remain
admin.resolveRoutingFirst: Save or cancel routing changes before removing a connection.
admin.removeConnectionHelp: Remove {name} and its picker entries. Existing routing bindings to this connection will move to {replacement}; model IDs are kept. Check the replacement's model support.
admin.removeConnectionRoles: Affected application roles: {roles}. Conversation overrides are not rewritten by this action.
admin.providerModelsHelp: Models sent through {name}. List changes save immediately.
admin.noMatchingModels: No registered models match. You can enter a model ID manually.
admin.modelLabelLimit: Display name: up to {max} characters. Model ID is unchanged.
admin.modelLabelTooLong: Shorten this display name to {max} characters or fewer before saving. The saved name has not been changed.
admin.noRegisteredModels: No model IDs are registered for this connection.
admin.emptyPickerFallback: No models from this provider appear in the picker. Existing chat bindings and background-task settings are unchanged.
admin.registrationNotTest: Registration adds a model ID to the picker; it does not verify provider support.
admin.duplicateModel: This model ID is already registered for this connection.
admin.removeModelHelp: Remove {model} from this connection's picker list. Application routing and existing conversation selections are not changed.
admin.storageLocationHelp: This does not change your browser's download location. Manage existing files in app Settings.
admin.storageNoMigration: Saving this configuration does not move existing files to the new location.
admin.backendLocalStorage: Files are stored on the machine running the backend, which may not be the device running this browser.
admin.bucketTestHelp: Makes a real bucket-access request. This checks access without migrating your files.
admin.embeddingsHelp: Convert document passages into vectors for search.
admin.embeddingChangeWarning: This does not reindex existing documents. Keep the model and vector dimensions compatible with your index.
admin.localDownloadHelp: Saving may load and download this model. Selecting it here does not.
admin.embeddingTestHelp: Sends a short embedding request and checks the returned dimensions. Provider quota or charges may apply. A changed endpoint requires an explicitly entered key for this test.
admin.modelPathHelp: The path must exist on the machine running the backend, with the dependencies required by that model.
admin.hybridEnabled: BM25 lexical retrieval is enabled and managed by the backend.
admin.hybridNotReported: Hybrid lexical retrieval is not reported as enabled. This page does not change that policy.
admin.rerankerHelp: Rank retrieved passages before sending them to the answer model.
admin.contextCountHelp: The number of highest-ranked passages retained for synthesis (3–30).
admin.rerankerDownloadHelp: Runs local model work and may download an uncached reranker. Saving can also load the selected model.
admin.sourceReadOnly: Read-only. Switching providers requires a backend restart.
admin.changeSourceHelp: Restart the backend through the chosen vault's CLI to change its provider. Direct Infisical launches require INFISICAL_INJECTED=1. Restart without vault runtime markers to return to local configuration.
admin.noPurge: Existing .env files are not deleted automatically. File removal and live provider switching are not available here.
admin.metadataNotSession: Project and environment names alone do not establish an active vault session.
admin.statusHelp: Read-only data from the last successful status request. Missing metrics are not evidence of a healthy service.
admin.refreshingStatus: Refreshing status; previous values remain visible…
admin.statusUnavailable: System status could not be loaded. Check the backend connection and use Refresh to retry.
admin.staleStatus: Refresh failed. These are last-known values, not a current health result. Use Refresh to retry.
admin.indexUnavailable: The document index reported an error. Review its service before assuming search is available.
admin.noCollections: No index collections were reported. This can be expected before documents have been indexed.
